newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bruton announces 315 new jobs in northeast region.
newsitem.headline: Bruton announces 315 new jobs in northeast region.

text.p: Irish enterprise and employment minister Richard Bruton said on Wednesday that 315 jobs were being created in eleven different companies in the northeast region, involving state investment of around 10 million Irish pounds.

"The companies are drawn from a number of diverse but growing sectors including internationally traded services, the prepared consumer foods sector, and the construction and consumer products area and will provide a variety of employment opportunities for a wide mix of skilled people," Bruton said in a statement.
The largest number of jobs will result from a major expansion at Mallon Technology Ltd in Dundalk which will grow permanent employment to 125 from 25.
